notes.title: PASSIONERS Update is Live!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce a brand-new update for PASSIONERS! Our team has been working behind the scenes to refine your experience, ensuring that everything flows as smoothly as your most intimate fantasies. With this latest patch, you can expect visual polish, subtle quality-of-life improvements, and enhanced performance that keeps things hot and hassle-free.

While the changes may not all be visible at first glance, you’ll feel the difference in every sensual interaction. Thanks for joining us on this steamy journey — more content is coming soon, and it's only getting spicier from here!

notes.title: Collectible Card Update: New Badges and Profile Backgrounds!
notes.content:
Great news for all PASSIONERS fans! We've just launched an exciting update that introduces collectible trading cards, shiny new badges, and exclusive profile backgrounds. Dive deeper into your cosmic journey by unlocking these unique rewards and showcasing them on your Steam profile. Complete your set to unlock special avatars and display your passion for PASSIONERS in style.

Ready to start collecting and show off your achievements? The adventure awaits—get started today!
